Setup: Show the trending outfit context clearly. Script: "We are focusing on the tranquil, grand feeling of the Prophet's Mosque. Keep your shots smooth and focused." Core: Share the main idea and its appeal. Script: "Viral clips use slow pans over the architecture and lighting. This shows reverence and draws viewers in instantly." Show: Demonstrate the idea with a quick example. Script: "Film close-ups of the beautiful arches or green domes, using soft, uplifting background music for mood." Peak: Highlight the biggest reaction moment. Script: "Show a wide, clear view of the main prayer hall-that moment of quiet beauty is the peak!" Outro: Invite opinions with a short CTА. Script: "What's your favorite part of this holy place?"
